descriptions.text: Interdiction Rapid-Response Railway Repair Cart. Contraption. Main Passenger-Line Gauged. The main workhorse vehicle of the Hobgoblin Interdiction Team. Includes battery power or powered track selection option. Includes portal track selector. Includes dual-destination, selectable debris scoop. […] The debris scoop will safely transport any active and running trains and their passengers back to the railyard. Once the wreck is reached, the debris scoop is switched to abyss mode, clearing the line of the damage. […] Unfortunately, the corporation running the Iron Tangle has little trust for the hobgoblins and requires security to escort these vehicles at all times. As such, this cart may only be started by a pair of gnolls.

beats.headline: A blade that is a portal
beats.text: Growler Gary tells them to take an interdiction team cart: dial in a line and it goes, on batteries even with the power out, and take a lead car, with the front portal. The yard holds unpowered trailers too heavy to lift, flatbed auxiliary carts with an outboard engine, and ten rapid-response carts that have never been used, each with a wide, flat blade across the front like a squeegee. The blade is a mobile portal. It fills the tunnel ahead and throws everything on the track, trains included, to a trainyard or into the abyss. Only a pair of gnoll hands on two sensor plates will start one. Mongo kills the sleeping Gary and bites off both his arms at the elbow.

beats.headline: Two carts down each line
beats.text: Three groups of crawlers are stranded at the abyss at the ends of different lines, and Carl's plan is not to drive at all: start a cart, set it on the right track, and let it run to the end. The first draft scoops everything to a trainyard, the crawlers too. Katia and Bautista point out what else is on those tracks, crashed trains and possibly thousands of ghouls, and what the crawlers would be thrown into. So each line gets two carts. The first has its portal tuned to the abyss, to clear the way. Fifteen minutes behind it comes a second, its portal tuned to the train station, for the crawlers to stand in front of.

beats.headline: Six carts, six alarms
beats.text: Each portal is a two-way switch, abyss or trainyard, and each cart's trainyard is different, painted on the edge of each cart; only one is tuned to trainyard E, where they came in, so that cart stays. The carts make almost no noise, so Carl fixes an alarm trap to all six, to let the stranded crawlers hear the portal coming. He engages the first engine, checks that the portal is set to the abyss and the cart dialled to the right portal, and watches it shoot down the track, hit the portal and disappear. Katia and Donut send the last three while he wires explosives to the back of the vermillion train.

beats.headline: A crane over the hole
beats.text: Crawlers build a five-legged crane over the station's five stairwells, two train wheels on top for the pulley, and Imani's magical chain lifts the back of an interdiction cart until it hangs vertically, front down, like a prize fish. Carl climbs his handmade ladder to the cockpit, pats the two Growler Gary left hands still in place, and turns the portal on, tuned to the abyss. Facing down, it is almost exactly the size of the marble circle in the centre of the room. At one day left, across the Tangle the centres of the stations fall away and Krakaren monsters pour in. Back in their station, the monsters are falling into the portal headfirst, feet first and sideways. Thousands of them, and they keep coming.

beats.headline: Grull, thrown away
beats.text: Grull is loose in Trainyard E, melting through its far side with his heat breath, when the portal cart comes barrelling in with Zhang at the controls. Li Na has kept the second mantaur alive as nothing but a torso and a head, which makes him easier to throw. Five punches start the summoning, and Grull turns and gallops at them. They toss the mumbling mantaur up at the oncoming cart, and with one second left, the body enters the portal and disappears. Grull, readying some massive, body-glowing attack, whiffs away, leaving only a smoke outline in the air. The music stops.

beats.headline: The Nightmare into the abyss
beats.text: With five hours to the collapse, they carry the portal cart, turn it and set it on the employee track, its wheels just inside the wider rails. The Nightmare is loaded with explosive satchels, meant to blow up in the abyss and take loads of Krakaren monsters with it, maybe the province boss too. Fire Brandy and Tizquick have chosen to stay aboard; Carl says goodbye to them and steps off. The train backs up to the edge of the trainyard, whistles twice, speeds toward the portal and disappears. Zhang climbs back into the cart and turns the portal off.
